scope: One optimized fixed10k,120-sample,400-actual-cell diagnostic with Go CPU profiling enabled and historical setup/ready/end external ps observers. Not observer-free, not five runs, not a P6 budget qualification, not GPU/presentation or thread-CPU attribution. No runtime changes or new native run during readout.

cpu_profile.warning: Cumulative categories overlap; never add these percentages. Sampled process-wide CPU includes observers, runtime scheduling and CGo boundaries, and does not map directly to phase wall-work durations.

source_evidence.fact: Every materialized cell/header calls place, which calls Text.Update; syncGrid subsequently calls host.Update over the same descendants.
WidgetBase.Update traverses the subtree, running UpdateWidget and Style, then marks layout needed.
Text updater parses rich text and configures allocation.
Changed paintSource rasterizes commands and passes the complete scene image bounds to Drawer.Copy.
UseGoImage skips an existing image upload only when unchanged; otherwise it uploads it.
SetFromGoImage writes the complete RGBA image extent from origin zero.

next_checkpoint_proposal: First instrument/count per-cell update/style, host traversal, scene raster calls and uploaded byte extents using opt-in bounded diagnostics. Preserve ordinary budget runs with diagnostics disabled.

Trial a single host update after the batch rather than per-cell plus host traversals. Verify theme/cursor/selection/edit-field styles, source replacements, pane movement, stale refs and fractional-DPI image equality. This is a source-backed redundant-work candidate, but syncGrid is only2.06% of sampled CPU; it is not established as the dominant bottleneck.

Investigate changed-scene image upload/raster invalidation separately: the texture-write call chain is24.87% cumulative in this profile. A bounded dirty-region or grid-specific rendering path would need independent pixel/clip correctness, cache retirement and precise uploaded-byte evidence; do not change generic rendering based solely on one profile.

After any qualified runtime optimization, use the corrected end-only observer launcher and unchanged≥400-cell workload/thresholds. Compare≥5 release runs per10k/million fixed/variable case. Preserve this baseline failure rather than lowering the target.
limitations: Historical diagnostic timings remain affected by profiling and setup/ready ps observers.
Go allocation deltas include measurement helpers and other Go goroutines, not framework-only allocation.
No dominant-source inference from phase percentiles or sums of cumulative CPU categories.
